model_input_features.name: input_ids
model_input_features.description: Subword Byte-Pair Encoded (BPE) token IDs from source code using GraphCodeBERT tokenizer

model_input_features.name: attention_mask
model_input_features.description: Binary attention mask (1 for active code tokens, 0 for padded positions)

model_target_features.name: label
model_target_features.description: Binary vulnerability status (1 = Vulnerable, 0 = Patched/Benign) for BCEWithLogitsLoss

model_target_features.name: cwe
model_target_features.description: Multi-class CWE vulnerability category index (top 20 + OTHER = 21 classes) for CrossEntropyLoss

tabular_metadata_features.name: code
tabular_metadata_features.role: Raw function source code before tokenization

tabular_metadata_features.name: language
tabular_metadata_features.role: Programming language (c, cpp, csharp, go, java, javascript, python)

tabular_metadata_features.name: project
tabular_metadata_features.role: Repository identifier used for zero-leakage GroupShuffleSplit

tabular_metadata_features.name: cwe
tabular_metadata_features.role: Canonical CWE taxonomy identifier (e.g. CWE-78, CWE-89)

tabular_metadata_features.name: id
tabular_metadata_features.role: Unique hash identifier for sample provenance tracking
